sentences.quote: SAGES (Societe Auxiliaire de Gestion), as Non-Managing General Partner of the Compagnie Generale des Etablissements Michelin (CGEM), headed by Mr. Vincent Montagne, has decided to renew Mr. Florent Menegaux' term as Managing General Partner. Michelin's Supervisory Board, chaired by Mrs. Barbara Dalibard, has unanimously agreed to this decision on January 12, 2026.
sentences.text: SAGES, the non-managing general partner headed by Vincent Montagne, renewed Florent Menegaux's term as Managing General Partner for up to four years, unanimously approved by the Supervisory Board chaired by Barbara Dalibard on January 12, 2026.

After Yves Chapot declined renewal, SAGES proposed Philippe Jacquin, Executive Vice President for R&D, as General Manager, approved at the May 22, 2026 Shareholders Meeting, where Chapot made his final appearance and Jacquin was welcomed as Managing Partner.
Benedicte de Bonnechose, on the Executive Committee since 2021 and previously overseeing Europe and transportation business lines, became Chief Financial Officer on June 1, 2026, succeeding Chapot.
